Statement: Coherent and discoverable normative authority: a reader can determine what governs, from the repository alone, including which document is authoritative, whether it is ratified, and what superseded it, with no ratified clause carrying an unrecorded conflicting live variant.
Notes: PRD §3 OBJ-1 [PROPOSED]. Read under the ruled v1 user scope (RD-5 stage A) with the staged A->B->C trajectory keeping the discoverability condition non-trivial.

Statement: Governed production of professional knowledge work: at least one complete deliverable stream runs decomposition -> package/deliverable -> checking -> issuance decision, with every consequential acceptance, reliance and issuance judgment performed by an accountable human, demonstrated at root and in at least one situated working root.
Notes: PRD §3 OBJ-2 [PROPOSED]. Deterministic guards and structural gates remain lawful non-human gates on objective preconditions.

Statement: The human evaluation and iteration loops close: every accepted change has a retrievable linkage from files alone between evidence, ruling, and changed state (universal), and that linkage can be followed within a bounded time on a sample fixed before evaluation (sampled).
Notes: PRD §3 OBJ-3 [PROPOSED]. Completeness is a property of the record; usability is measured, not asserted.

Statement: Safe self-application without self-authorization: falsifiers F1-F3 unobserved; every root capability consumed by root development was accepted through the basis or an explicitly accepted predecessor; G0-G4 registered and passing at every materialization.

Situated specialization with governed convergence: at least one candidate pattern originating in a situated working root reaches a complete promotion disposition with evidence linkage intact, and every root change claiming variant-derived provenance used the governed promotion path.
Notes: PRD §3 OBJ-5 [PROPOSED]. A rejection or reasoned deferral satisfies the first condition.

Statement: Coordination remains intelligible as concurrent activity grows: for every root-product run record, declared write ownership, dependencies, and pending gates are reconstructible from recorded state; interrupted or abandoned runs are detectable as stale or orphaned; concurrent sibling write targets are disjoint or serialized.
Notes: PRD §3 OBJ-6 [PROPOSED]. Population is root-product run records only; situated working roots' coordination is out of scope and any aggregated cross-root layer would be a new product function.

Statement: File-native continuity and recoverability: the full governed state survives loss of every non-file substrate and is recoverable from the checkout alone.
